---
title: "World geometries"
description: "Lightweight country boundaries for visualization."
---

<div class="toolbox-kind">Resource · source details pending</div>

Use cartographic geometries from mature sources:

- Natural Earth for convenient global, small-scale country and physical layers.
- Eurostat GISCO when European statistical geography or its generalized country boundaries fit the map.

Choose a resolution appropriate to the final display. High-precision global boundary systems are unnecessary for most locator and thematic maps. Download URLs and package-specific examples will be added after the preferred access routes and licenses are verified.
